name: Ancient Chinese Prophecy 中国古代谶语卡组
description: 24 prophecies, child-rhymes and omen verses recorded in official histories (Qin to Qing), grouped by dynasty (preface / Qin / Han / Jin / Sui / Tang / Five Dynasties / Song / Yuan / Ming / Qing), each with source citation and plain-language commentary. Companion web tool provides a dynasty timeline (one band per dynasty, order taken from the data itself - add a new dynasty and it just appears) + cards with read-aloud for the verse and the commentary. Research-oriented material, not superstition. 24 条史书所载谶语/童谣/谣谶（秦至清），按朝代分组，带出处与白话疏解；配套小工具提供朝代时间轴（一代一段，顺序取自数据）与卡片，谶语与疏解可点读。定位历史考据素材，非宣扬迷信。
author: Alfred Long
